title: Madeline McIntosh (Authors Equity; ex-CEO, Penguin Random House US) on Masters of Scale — the Ries–Tippett conversation was her 'personal highlight'
summary: McIntosh co-founded Authors Equity after running Penguin Random House US, and sat through a programme that included Reid Hoffman, Eric Schmidt, Maria Ressa and Reed Hastings. She picked Eric's conversation with Krista Tippett of On Being as the thing she took away, and read the conference as a whole as turning toward humanity.
blockquote: Personal highlight for me was listening to these two in excellent conversation.  Thank you Eric Ries and Krista Tippett!
attribution_title: Co-founder, Authors Equity · former CEO, Penguin Random House US
